info.title: Global B2B Email, MX, SPF & DMARC Deliverability Auditor
info.description:
High-speed asynchronous B2B email and corporate domain auditor via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare & Google DNS). Validates RFC 5322 syntax, disposable domains, MX records, email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast), SPF, and DMARC policies.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (Global B2B Email, MX, SPF & DMARC Deliverability Auditor)
- **Target B2B Buyers:** B2B Outbound Platforms, FinTech Onboarding Anti-Fraud Engines, and SOC Security Teams.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`B2B Email / Corporate Domain Audited`).
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Cybersecurity` | Zyla API Hub `Security`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** email-verification, dmarc-spf-mx, domain-security, disposable-email, kyb-fraud-prevention, b2b-lead-hygiene, secops.

import httpx

url = "https://b2b-quant-rapidapi-gateway.jesleytassili.workers.dev/v1/global-b2b-email-domain-security-auditor"
payload = {
    "targets": [
        "contact@openai.com",
        "sales@stripe.com",
        "fake@mailinator.com"
    ],
    "checkDmarcAndSpf": true
}
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "global-b2b-email-domain-security-auditor.p.rapidapi.com",
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "<YOUR_RAPIDAPI_OR_ZYLA_KEY>",
}

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.json())

GlobalB2bEmailDomainSecurityAuditorReque.description: Input parameters for Global B2B Email, MX, SPF & DMARC Deliverability Auditor.

targets.title: Target Emails or Domains
targets.description: List of email addresses or domain names to audit

checkDmarcAndSpf.title: Audit SPF & DMARC Security Policies
checkDmarcAndSpf.description: Query TXT records for SPF and _dmarc policies

GlobalB2bEmailDomainSecurityAuditorRecor.title: Global B2B Email, MX, SPF & DMARC Deliverability Auditor Output Record
GlobalB2bEmailDomainSecurityAuditorRecor.description: Enriched B2B dataset item returned by `global-b2b-email-domain-security-auditor`.

inputTarget.title: Input Target
inputTarget.description: Original email address or domain submitted for audit

isValidSyntax.title: Valid Syntax
isValidSyntax.description: Whether the input satisfies RFC 5322 email or DNS hostname syntax

isDisposable.title: Disposable Domain
isDisposable.description: Whether the domain belongs to a known temporary/disposable email provider

isRoleAccount.title: Role Account
isRoleAccount.description: Whether the email local-part is a generic role address (sales@, admin@, support@, etc.)

hasMxRecords.title: Has MX Records
hasMxRecords.description: Whether the domain has active Mail Exchange (MX) DNS records

emailProvider.title: Email Provider
emailProvider.description: Detected B2B email provider or gateway from MX records

hasSpf.title: Has SPF
hasSpf.description: Whether the domain publishes a valid v=spf1 TXT policy

hasDmarc.title: Has DMARC
hasDmarc.description: Whether _dmarc.<domain> publishes a valid v=DMARC1 TXT policy

dmarcPolicy.title: DMARC Policy
dmarcPolicy.description: Extracted DMARC enforcement policy (reject, quarantine, none, missing, or skipped)

deliverabilityScore.title: Deliverability Score
deliverabilityScore.description: Composite B2B deliverability and domain security score (0-100)

quantScore.title: Quantitative Compliance & Opportunity Score (0-100)
quantScore.description: Normalized deterministic score from 0 to 100 generated by the quantitative engine.
